headline: Artificial intelligence drove Microsoft to a record 622-flaw Patch Tuesday and now runs intrusions on its own, as SonicWall, SharePoint, and decade-old Secure Boot zero-days force emergency patching worldwide.

emerging_trends.text: Artificial intelligence now works both sides of the vulnerability ledger, discovering the flaws behind Microsoft's record patch count while Check Point documents attackers who let AI generate thousands of exploitation commands autonomously across dozens of sessions.
emerging_trends.topic_title: AI Runs Attacks and Botnets on Its Own

emerging_trends.text: Actively exploited zero-days keep landing on internet-facing gear, with SonicWall SMA1000 appliances and on-premises SharePoint servers both under attack and freshly added to CISA's Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog.
emerging_trends.topic_title: SonicWall SMA1000 Zero-Days Under Active Attack

emerging_trends.text: Criminals keep salting open developer ecosystems, poisoning four @asyncapi npm packages with a botnet loader and standing up nearly 300 impostor GitHub repositories to push infostealers.
emerging_trends.topic_title: npm and GitHub Poisoned to Spread Malware

topics.title: Microsoft's Record 622-Flaw Patch Tuesday
topics.latest_developments: Microsoft shipped fixes on July 14, 2026 for a record 622 CVEs by its own count—Krebs tallies 570 Windows-specific holes, nearly triple June's prior record—including two zero-days already under attack, Active Directory Federation Services flaw CVE-2026-56155 and SharePoint Server flaw CVE-2026-56164, plus a publicly disclosed BitLocker bug; Microsoft blocked the update on some Dell PCs after shutdowns, and CISA urged SharePoint hardening against an exploitation chain of CVE-2026-32201, CVE-2026-45659, and CVE-2026-56164.
topics.summary: The monthly release patches Windows and related software; Microsoft credits AI-assisted discovery for the ballooning counts and incident responders for both live zero-days. Administrators should prioritize the ADFS and SharePoint fixes and, for on-premises SharePoint, apply CISA's hardening steps.

sources.title: Microsoft Patches Record 622 Flaws, Including Two Zero-Days Under Active Attack
Microsoft Patches a Record 570 Security Flaws
CISA Urges SharePoint Hardening After New Exploitations
Microsoft: Some Dell PCs shut down after recent Windows updates

topics.title: SonicWall SMA1000 Zero-Days Under Active Attack
topics.latest_developments: SonicWall confirmed on July 14, 2026 active zero-day exploitation of two SMA1000 series flaws—server-side request forgery CVE-2026-15409 rated 10.0 and code-injection CVE-2026-15410, one of which enables unauthenticated remote command execution—released fixed firmware, and told customers showing indicators of compromise to re-image appliances and reset all passwords, as CISA added both to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog.
topics.summary: SonicWall's Secure Mobile Access 1000 appliances sit at the network edge for remote access, making unauthenticated command execution especially dangerous. Organizations must upgrade immediately and hunt for compromise.

sources.title: Two SonicWall SMA 1000 Zero-Days Exploited, One Could Enable Admin Commands
SonicWall warns of SMA1000 flaws exploited in zero-day attacks, patch now
SonicWall Issues Urgent SMA Patch Warning for Two Zero-Day Exploits
SonicWall SMA appliances targeted in zero-day attacks (CVE-2026-15409, CVE-2026-15410)

topics.title: AI Runs Attacks and Botnets on Its Own
topics.latest_developments: Check Point's AI Security Report 2026, published July 15, 2026, documented intrusions in which AI autonomously ran exploitation workflows generating thousands of commands across dozens of sessions with minimal human direction, while Palo Alto's Unit 42 dissected TuxBot v3, an IoT botnet framework built with LLM assistance, and Michigan Technological University showed an overthinking attack that ties up a vision-language-model robot for over a minute.
topics.summary: Attackers are wiring capable models into every stage of the kill chain and abusing how robots read text in camera frames. Defenders face faster, less-supervised campaigns and a new class of denial-of-service against embodied AI.

sources.title: AI used to help plan the break-in, now it's doing the break-in
TuxBot v3: Inside an IoT Botnet Framework With LLM-Assisted Development
An AI overthinking attack can tie a robot up for over a minute

topics.title: npm and GitHub Poisoned to Spread Malware
topics.latest_developments: OX Security, SafeDep, Socket, and StepSecurity found four compromised @asyncapi npm packages delivering a multi-stage botnet loader on July 15, 2026, as a threat actor stood up nearly 300 fake GitHub repositories impersonating legitimate software and security projects to push infostealers, and Blackpoint Cyber flagged LabubaRAT, a Rust remote-access trojan posing as NVIDIA software.
topics.summary: The affected npm packages include @asyncapi/generator@3.3.1 and @asyncapi/specs, widely pulled by API tooling. Developers should pin known-good versions, scrutinize GitHub project provenance, and treat NVIDIA-branded binaries from untrusted sources as suspect.

sources.title: Compromised AsyncAPI npm Packages Deliver Multi-Stage Botnet Malware
Nearly 300 GitHub repos pose as legit software to push malware
LabubaRAT Masquerades as NVIDIA Software to Control Windows Hosts

topics.title: New Stealers Hunt Crypto Wallets and Keychains
topics.latest_developments: Kaspersky's GReAT team detailed OkoBot on July 15, 2026, a framework that uses TookPS to exfiltrate seed phrases, watch Chromium browsers, and drop the Rilide stealer, while Jamf Threat Labs moved CrashStealer—a macOS infostealer posing as Apple's crash-reporting tool to grab passwords, Keychain data, and wallets—from development into in-the-wild use, and KU Leuven found 85 browser-extension wallets leaking addresses that enable cross-site tracking.
topics.summary: Cryptocurrency users face a widening set of stealers across Windows and macOS plus privacy leaks baked into popular wallet extensions. Users should verify software sources, isolate wallet browsers, and treat seed phrases as never-typed secrets.

sources.title: OkoBot: new sophisticated malware framework targets cryptocurrency users
New macOS malware steals passwords by posing as Apple's crash-reporting tool
Study of 85 Crypto Wallet Extensions Finds Address Leaks and Cross-Site Tracking Risks

topics.title: Decade-Old Secure Boot Bypass Exposed
topics.latest_developments: Researchers revealed on July 14, 2026 that Microsoft failed for roughly a decade to revoke old, forgotten signed shims, leaving Secure Boot trivially bypassable on most systems, and separately catalogued 11 old Microsoft-signed Linux UEFI applications that let an attacker run untrusted code during boot and plant bootkits.
topics.summary: Secure Boot verifies that only trusted code loads at startup; the stale Microsoft-signed components let attackers defeat that check and install malware that survives reinstalls. Affected systems need the revoked-certificate and firmware updates.

sources.title: Microsoft's Secure Boot has been broken for a decade and no one noticed until now
11 Old Microsoft-Signed Linux UEFI Shims Could Let Attackers Bypass Secure Boot

business_politics.title: U.S.-Iran War Escalates as Oil Nears $86
business_politics.latest_developments: Tehran threatened to halt all Middle East energy exports after the U.S. reimposed its naval blockade of Iranian ports, Brent crude climbed near $86 a barrel on a fourth straight night of U.S. strikes, and Senate Democrats blocked a $1 trillion defense bill in protest of the war.
business_politics.summary: The United States has battled Iran for weeks over control of the Strait of Hormuz, the chokepoint for roughly a fifth of the world's seaborne liquefied natural gas, and Iranian attacks have already erased 17% of Qatar's LNG export capacity as Europe scrambles to fill storage before winter. President Trump also moved to withdraw all U.S. forces from Iraq by the end of September, closing a 23-year presence.

sources.title: Oil Rises After U.S. Reimposed Naval Blockade on Iran

business_politics.title: China's Growth Slows to Weakest Since 2022
business_politics.latest_developments: China's economy expanded 4.3% in the second quarter, one of its lowest rates in decades and below Beijing's target range, as feeble domestic demand offset surging exports.
business_politics.summary: China's gross domestic product cooled more than economists expected, undercutting Beijing's roughly 5% annual goal and pointing to deepening weakness in consumer spending and property that ripples through global commodity and trade flows.

sources.title: China's Economy Grows at Weakest Pace Since 2022

business.summary: Marshall's, a Shell station deli in Spring Garden, sells what Pittsburgh City Paper calls the region's best Reuben sandwich, and the online attention has driven a surge of new business.

around_town.latest_developments: Allegheny County Council voted Tuesday to pull from the November ballot a proposed charter amendment that would have asked voters to lift the 0.4% annual limit on council's operating budget.
around_town.summary: In a swift reversal, Allegheny County Council abandoned its plan to let voters eliminate the cap that holds its own operating-budget increases to 0.4% a year.
